items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: We had three trombonists -- Claude Jones, a guy named Freddie Robinson, I don't know if you remember him; he had a great tone. >> [INTERVIEWER] Is that Robinson or Robertson? [INTERVIEWEE] Robinson.

ctx.x: Well, Benny was in that great band. We had three trombonists -- Claude Jones, a guy named Freddie Robinson, I don't know if you remember him; he had a great tone.
